description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Effect You make a cutting comment about a foe, making it difficult for them to concentrate. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:will] check against the Will DC of a creature within 30 feet. On a success, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} until the end of its next turn or until it damages you, whichever comes first.
